_comment: Mirror of docs/research/gapper-study-2026-11/params.json decisionTimesEt (IP-T443, IP-LAW-7). The live GapperFormationWorker writes one GapperFormationSnapshot row per symbol at exactly these ET clock times so live rows and study rows compare row for row. 'D-1 16:00' is the study's prior-close reference, not a live decision time, and is skipped by the loader. Core must not depend on docs, hence the copy; keep the two lists identical.
